 Most recent Most popular FULL-TIME published at 18:26 GMT 18:26 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 It's a first Anfield win for Mikel Arteta as Arsenal boss and it means so much. 
 The champions move three points clear. 
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 90+6 mins 90+6 mins 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Alexander Isak gives Gabriel the shove he needs to go down and win the free-kick. 
 This is probably it.

 Remarkable that Raya hasn't been tested published at 18:23 GMT 18:23 GMT 
 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Aadam Patel 
Football Reporter at Anfield 
 This has been a masterclass in defending from Arsenal. But given the talent within Liverpool's ranks, it is remarkable that David Raya has hardly been tested.

 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal

 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal

 Liverpool have the ball, but Arsenal are controlling where they can play it. That’s the difference between defending deep and defending intelligently.
 Katie, Oxford 
 Same old Liverpool, blow hot and cold every game. Possession counts for nothing nor shots when nothing comes of it. An away win incoming.
 Steven, Whitworth

 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal

Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Hincapie is going in at left-back and Calafiori is sitting in the left-wing position. They are saying ' we will contain the right hand side and go more defensive if we need to' and they are happy to do that.

 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal

 Can Liverpool nick something?

 Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal 
 Stephen Warnock 
Former Liverpool defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Munoz is going to come on at right-back. He played here when they went down to 10 men against Brentford. Iraola spoke and said that it gives them another option there. I wondered when he'd play there [again] because he looked very promising.
 He will help Rio Ngumoha on that right-hand side.
